purpose: Derive one public line for each repository from the epistemic operation it owns, not from a promotional summary of its result.
definition: A repository thought is the shortest sentence that states which distinction the repository makes scientifically consequential, which collapse it refuses, and what responsibility it passes forward.
construction_rules: The line must remain true when the preferred hypothesis fails.
The line must describe an epistemic operation, not merely a topic, taxon, method or result.
Sibling repositories must not receive interchangeable lines.
The line must respect the repository claim ceiling and must not borrow a stronger claim from the next repository.
Negative, bounded, unavailable and set-valued outcomes must be expressible without apology or rescue language.
The public line stays short; its preserved distinction and refused collapse remain auditable here.

series_logic.azami: recover variation before averaging, then separate recurrence from historical localization
series_logic.flower: place variation in space, separate visible and molecular identity through time, then resolve one polymorphic system across scales
series_logic.island: unpack the island label into context, conditional response and trait-specific divergence
series_logic.observation: preserve a revisitable record, preserve unresolved evidence, then define what judgment the record licenses
series_logic.method: bound mechanism allocation, choose observations that split worlds, separate update from prediction, enforce external gates, and seal the answer check
series_logic.theory: define safe forgetting, expose future/history/mechanism obligations, license reports from evidence, test dynamic sufficiency and warning, then connect without centralizing ownership

thoughts.line: 平均は、種を代表するほど、種の内側を消す。
thoughts.epistemic_move: recover within-taxon continuous variation before taxon-level compression
thoughts.preserves: individual/observation-level phenotype structure and trait-specific spatial geography
thoughts.refuses: taxon mean as the phenotype itself

thoughts.line: 反復は数えられても、起点は一つに定まらない。
thoughts.epistemic_move: separate robust recurrence bounds from transition localization
thoughts.preserves: minimum recurrence and topology-sensitive historical uncertainty
thoughts.refuses: minimum change counts as independent origin, convergence or adaptation

thoughts.line: 同じ変異が、ある場所では共存し、別の場所では地図になる。
thoughts.epistemic_move: treat local coexistence and geographic differentiation as distinct spatial organizations of variation
thoughts.preserves: where variation is organized, not only whether it exists
thoughts.refuses: present spatial organization as one maintenance mechanism or evolutionary history

thoughts.line: 同じ色は、同じ分子の道を丸ごと必要としない。
thoughts.epistemic_move: separate visible state, molecular implementation and historical event identity
thoughts.preserves: transition-class-dependent modular recurrence and event uncertainty
thoughts.refuses: visible similarity as complete molecular or evolutionary identity

thoughts.line: 一つの多型は、解像するほど一つではなくなる。
thoughts.epistemic_move: resolve one polymorphic system across phenotype, spatial scale and ecological context
thoughts.preserves: multiple non-equivalent layers of the same named polymorphism
thoughts.refuses: one causal or analytical reduction across all layers

thoughts.line: 島という一語が、異なる過程を一つの症候群に畳む。
thoughts.epistemic_move: separate observation process and ask when/where multivariate responses differ
thoughts.preserves: context-specific response vectors and unresolved regional testability
thoughts.refuses: distance as pure isolation treatment and no record as trait zero

thoughts.line: 同じ攪乱でも、出発点と出会いが未来の枝を選ぶ。
thoughts.epistemic_move: condition one perturbation on starting state and realized community
thoughts.preserves: mean response geometry and community-conditioned individual branching
thoughts.refuses: one universal monotonic post-perturbation response

thoughts.line: 花は島で一方向に変わらず、形質ごとにほどける。
thoughts.epistemic_move: decompose one flower into phenotype axes with separate island structure
thoughts.preserves: trait-specific divergence in dimensions, entrance form, reproductive organs and guide coverage
thoughts.refuses: one island-syndrome score or Pst as selection evidence

thoughts.line: 観測は、判断より先に、戻れる記録でなければならない。
thoughts.epistemic_move: physically separate the primary scientific record from machine candidate decisions
thoughts.preserves: fixed-effort image sequences, shadow provenance and later reinspection
thoughts.refuses: candidate decisions or adaptive image counts as visit truth

thoughts.line: 未決定は、答えの欠如ではなく、証拠の保存である。
thoughts.epistemic_move: retain target, nuisance, observability and absence evidence as non-complementary dimensions
thoughts.preserves: distinct reasons for unresolved evidence
thoughts.refuses: low target support as certified absence or nuisance truth

thoughts.line: 観測が与えるのは答えではなく、答えてよい範囲である。
thoughts.epistemic_move: convert observation records into explicit downstream judgment entitlement
thoughts.preserves: B/T/N/U and reason-preserving abstention
thoughts.refuses: raw thresholds and binary coarsening as transferable ecological decisions

thoughts.line: 総効果は、原因を束ねるが、原因を割り当てない。
thoughts.epistemic_move: read interaction effects as identified sets rather than unique allocations
thoughts.preserves: compatible channel allocations and the interventions required to shrink them
thoughts.refuses: mechanism naming by subtraction from a precise total effect

thoughts.line: よい観測は、答えを増やすのではなく、残る世界を減らす。
thoughts.epistemic_move: choose the next observation by how it separates surviving causal worlds
thoughts.preserves: admissible causal sets, calibration conditions and observation order
thoughts.refuses: rich simulation or accurate proxy as mechanism identification

thoughts.line: 更新のために覚え、予測のために忘れる。
thoughts.epistemic_move: separate exact update/falsification identity from label-invariant predictive representation
thoughts.preserves: auditable world histories and predictive summaries that do not depend on world names
thoughts.refuses: discarding identity or treating identity itself as predictive value

thoughts.line: 正の結果でも、決めた門を通らなければ一般化ではない。
thoughts.epistemic_move: give preregistered full-gate logic priority over favorable average outcomes
thoughts.preserves: validated Japanese candidate patches and failed external promotion
thoughts.refuses: positive lift or six passed gates as success when the seventh gate fails

thoughts.line: 答えを見る前に、何を答えと呼ぶかを凍らせる。
thoughts.epistemic_move: freeze candidate universe, method and full denominator outside the sealed answer check
thoughts.preserves: supported, unavailable, non-estimable and STOP as legitimate terminal states
thoughts.refuses: post-opening repair of predictors, denominator or success conditions

thoughts.line: 状態とは、世界そのものではなく、責任をもって忘れた世界である。
thoughts.epistemic_move: construct state as the coarsest contract-adequate quotient of temporally extended worlds
thoughts.preserves: differences required by future, history, mechanism, evidence and report responsibility
thoughts.refuses: snapshot or intrinsic natural classification as unconditional state

thoughts.line: 未来にできることが増えると、現在に残すべき差も増える。
thoughts.epistemic_move: let an enlarged future grammar refine present representational obligation
thoughts.preserves: counterfactual response distinctions made relevant by newly legal futures
thoughts.refuses: same present description as sufficient under every future grammar

thoughts.line: 同じ現在でも、どこから来たかが意味を変える。
thoughts.epistemic_move: restore the minimum source/history context needed after replacement
thoughts.preserves: transportable laws, failed merges, least repair and necessary history modes
thoughts.refuses: same present form as same inherited operational meaning

thoughts.line: 姿が同じでも、未来への応答が違えば、同じ状態ではない。
thoughts.epistemic_move: retain only mechanism distinctions that can change contract-relevant future response
thoughts.preserves: deterministic common laws, typed laws and set-valued reports
thoughts.refuses: preserving every mechanism difference or forgetting them all

thoughts.line: 必要な差、見えた差、言ってよい差は一致しない。
thoughts.epistemic_move: separate required state, identified state and reportable target
thoughts.preserves: evidence-compatible ambiguity, target-safe refinement and false-resolution risk
thoughts.refuses: theoretically required distinctions as already observed or reportable

thoughts.line: 同じ周辺量でも、重なり方が次の遷移を変える。
thoughts.epistemic_move: separate equality of marginals from equality of cross-layer alignment
thoughts.preserves: configuration information in the explicit state that changes the next transition
thoughts.refuses: same census/interaction/allele marginals as the same dynamic state

thoughts.line: 先に起きることは、先を当てられることではない。
thoughts.epistemic_move: separate within-event temporal ordering from full-denominator predictive discrimination
thoughts.preserves: replicated ordering, zero specificity and state-conditional portability
thoughts.refuses: a pre-loss change as warning validity by itself

thoughts.line: 接続しても、証拠の住所は移さない。
thoughts.epistemic_move: connect typed research objects while leaving primary ownership and provenance distributed
thoughts.preserves: non-identity among Reality, ModelWorld, State, Evidence and Report plus source ownership
thoughts.refuses: registry, synthesis or centrality as ownership of source evidence or theorems
